context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 241 fully tested. Two P2 features: (1) Floorplan Position for ALL types - PUT /api/resources/{id}/floorplan now works for room, desk, and vehicle types. GET /api/floorplans/{id}/items?type=room|vehicle|desk filters by type. Admin UI has FloorplanEditTypeSwitcher (data-testid='floorplan-edit-type-switcher') with buttons for desk/room/vehicle (data-testid='floorplan-edit-type-desk' etc.). (2) Recurring Office-Days - GET/PUT /api/users/me/office-days for config, POST /api/users/me/office-days/generate creates desk bookings. Profile page has OfficeDaysSection (data-testid='office-days-block') with weekday chips (data-testid='office-day-mon' to -sun), desk selector (data-testid='office-day-desk-select'), time inputs, Save and Generate buttons. Validations: invalid weekday returns 400, invalid time format returns 400, end<=start returns 400, nonexistent desk returns 404. Generate is idempotent - second call skips already booked days.
